title: Typing Zoo
tags: typing,keyboarding,touch typing,keyboard,home row,typing practice,typing lessons,computer skills,fingers,pets,elementary,grade 1,grade 2,grade 3,grade 4,grade 5
description: Learn to type one key at a time. 40 short lessons, starting with F and J on the home row and building up to sentences, numbers and symbols, and whole paragraphs, plus 1, 3 and 5-minute typing tests, with colors that show which finger to use. Finish a lesson and you get an egg to crack, with a new pet inside. Get 3 stars for a golden egg and a shiny pet. There are 40 pets to collect.
notes: Plain DOM game (no kit). 40 lessons in five units (home row, top row, bottom row, big letters and sentences, numbers and symbols), each adding keys to the ones before; every lesson is 3 lines of 34 characters made from the allowed keys (letter drills, then real words and sentences). The next key is lit on an on-screen US QWERTY keyboard colored by finger, with the finger named under the line; the keys can be tapped, so it also works on a tablet. A wrong key shakes the line and must be fixed before moving on; it counts once per letter. Stars by accuracy: 3 at 95% or better, 2 at 85%, else 1. Speed is words a minute (5 characters a word, capped at 200). Each finished lesson gives an egg to crack (tap it 4 times); a 3-star lesson gives a golden egg and a shiny pet. 40 pets; once all are found, eggs make pets shiny. Lessons unlock in order. Timed tests (1, 3 and 5 minutes, chapter t1/t3/t5) open after Lesson 12 and keep each length's best run and the last 20 runs. 'Practice my tricky keys' (chapter=tricky) drills the keys missed most. Saved in BRB.storage key 'typing-pets-v1': per lesson best stars, best speed, best accuracy, tries and the last result; the pets; hits and misses per key; total seconds typed. Teachers see this in the class progress page (server/services/typing.js reads the saves). BRB.params chapter=l01..l20 with lock=1 opens just that lesson (a class lesson step); a finished lesson submits the speed as the score with the accuracy and stars in the label, then BRB.gameOver. window.__brbTest: lesson, type, typeAll, crackAll, pets, lessons, save.

es.title: Zoo del Teclado
es.description: Aprende a escribir con el teclado, tecla a tecla. 40 lecciones cortas, desde la F y la J hasta frases, con colores que muestran qué dedo usar. Al terminar cada lección rompes un huevo con una mascota nueva dentro. Hay 40 mascotas para coleccionar.

fr.title: Zoo du Clavier
fr.description: Apprends à taper au clavier, une touche à la fois. 40 petites leçons, de F et J jusqu’aux phrases, avec des couleurs qui montrent quel doigt utiliser. À la fin de chaque leçon, tu casses un œuf avec un nouvel animal dedans. 40 animaux à collectionner.

de.title: Tipp-Zoo
de.description: Lerne Tippen, eine Taste nach der anderen. 40 kurze Lektionen von F und J bis zu Sätzen, mit Farben, die zeigen, welcher Finger dran ist. Nach jeder Lektion knackst du ein Ei mit einem neuen Tier darin. 40 Tiere zum Sammeln.

it.title: Zoo della Tastiera
it.description: Impara a scrivere con la tastiera, un tasto alla volta. 40 brevi lezioni, dalla F e la J fino alle frasi, con i colori che mostrano quale dito usare. Alla fine di ogni lezione rompi un uovo con un nuovo cucciolo dentro. 40 cuccioli da collezionare.

pt.title: Zoo do Teclado
pt.description: Aprenda a digitar, uma tecla de cada vez. 40 lições curtas, do F e J até frases, com cores que mostram qual dedo usar. No fim de cada lição você quebra um ovo com um bichinho novo dentro. São 40 bichinhos para colecionar.

nl.title: Typdierentuin
nl.description: Leer typen, één toets tegelijk. 40 korte lessen, van F en J tot zinnen, met kleuren die laten zien welke vinger je gebruikt. Na elke les tik je een ei open met een nieuw dier erin. 40 dieren om te verzamelen.

ru.title: Клавиатурный зоопарк
ru.description: Учись печатать по одной клавише. 40 коротких уроков, от F и J до предложений, с цветами, которые показывают, каким пальцем нажимать. После каждого урока разбей яйцо, а внутри новый питомец. 40 питомцев для коллекции.

ja.title: タイピングどうぶつえん
ja.description: キーをひとつずつおぼえてタイピングを学ぼう。FとJから文まで、40のみじかいレッスン。どのゆびを使うかは色でわかるよ。レッスンが終わるとたまごをわって、新しいペットが生まれます。ペットは40ひき。
ja.tags: タイピング,キーボード,ブラインドタッチ,ゆび,れんしゅう,ペット,小学生

zh-Hant.title: 打字動物園
zh-Hant.description: 一次學一個鍵，學會打字。從 F 和 J 到句子，共 40 個短課程，用顏色告訴你該用哪根手指。每完成一課就能敲開一顆蛋，裡面有新寵物。共有 40 隻寵物可以收集。
zh-Hant.tags: 打字,鍵盤,盲打,手指,練習,寵物,小學

ar.title: حديقة حيوانات الكتابة
ar.description: تعلّم الكتابة على لوحة المفاتيح مفتاحًا بعد مفتاح. 40 درسًا قصيرًا من F وJ حتى الجمل، مع ألوان تبيّن أي إصبع تستخدم. بعد كل درس تكسر بيضة فيها حيوان أليف جديد. هناك 40 حيوانًا لتجمعها.

he.title: גן החיות של המקלדת
he.description: לומדים להקליד, מקש אחרי מקש. 40 שיעורים קצרים, מ-F ו-J ועד משפטים, עם צבעים שמראים באיזו אצבע להשתמש. בסוף כל שיעור שוברים ביצה ובתוכה חיה חדשה. יש 40 חיות לאסוף.
